tiers.biomes: Meadow, Forest, Birch Forest, Beach, Ocean
tiers.new_materials: wood, stone, flint, coal, copper, tin
iron (rare in T1 below y = 0), granite

mobs.behaviour: slow melee walker; burns in sunlight on the surface
3–5, circles and lunges; tamable is v2
sets the player on fire; explodes on death unless killed by a cold weapon

bosses.phases_and_attacks: Charge (telegraphed by pawing, dodge sideways), tusk sweep, at 50%: thorns burst from the ground in a ring
Slam with shockwave (jump it), throws boulders, at 50%: armour plates fall off, core exposed, takes 2× damage to the core
bosses.opens: Steel tier, blast furnace, waystones (Building), composite bow (Archery)

bosses.offering: 6 peat + 4 silver ingots + 1 swamp lily (wild in T3 swamps)
bosses.phases_and_attacks: Spawns bog slimes, poison pools, at 50%: submerges and surfaces under players
Flies in arcs, frost breath (cold), ice spikes from the ground, at 50%: blizzard (darkness, wind)
Lava waves, falling stalactites, at 66% and 33%: summons magma crawlers and changes arena lava height
bosses.opens: Legendary items, Hearthforged armour, Grand Hearth

trees.name: Woodcutting
trees.text: XP: chopping a natural log: oak and birch 4, pine 5, mangrove 7, frostpine 9, ashwood 12. Felling a whole tree (last log of a connected natural tree) +10. Leaves and saplings 0.

trees.name: Mining
trees.text: XP: stone 1, granite and darkstone 2, deepstone 3, coal 4, copper and tin 5, iron 8, silver 12, gold 14, gems 20, frostglass 25, deepiron 40. Dirt, sand and gravel give Mining XP 0.5 only with a shovel.

trees.name: Harvest
trees.text: XP: harvesting a ripe crop you or anyone planted: wheat, carrot, potato 3; flax, beetroot, onion, barley 4; pumpkin, melon, rice 6; frostroot 10; emberbloom 14. Picking berries 2, mushrooms 3, herbs 4, wild crops ×1.5. Tilling and planting 0.5 (capped, §3).

trees.name: Fishing
trees.text: XP per catch by rarity: junk 1, common 5, uncommon 12, rare 25, treasure 30, epic 40, legendary 60. Scaled by fish size (×0.8–1.3).

trees.name: Hunting
trees.text: XP for killing animals and beasts: chicken and rabbit 3, sheep and pig 5, cow and goat 6, deer 8, boar 10, wolf 10, cave spider 8, deep beasts 25. Elder animals ×3. (Wolves and spiders also give Attack XP for the damage.)

trees.name: Crafting
trees.text: The recipe gate for everything not made of metal: tools of wood and stone, wood and leather gear, furniture, containers, bows, mechanisms. XP: each recipe with "skill": "crafting" has a base_xp of 1–20 (sticks 0.2, planks 0.5, chest 4, bed 6, leather armour piece 8, longbow 15). Anti-exploit: §3.

trees.name: Smithing
trees.text: Anyone can smelt raw ore into ingots at a furnace someone built. Smithing gates the furnace recipe itself, alloys, the anvil and every metal item. XP: smelting (given to the player who loaded the ore, when the ingots come out): copper and tin ingot 2, bronze 3, iron 5, silver 7, gold 7, steel 8, frostglass 12, deepiron 15. Anvil recipes: 3 × the number of ingots used.

trees.name: Cooking
trees.text: Anyone can roast raw food on a campfire (a starting recipe). Cooking gates pots, ovens, meals with buffs, and feasts. XP per dish: roasted food 1, simple meals 3–5, stews and pies 6–10, feasts 15, rare-ingredient dishes (frostroot, emberbloom, legendary fish) 12–20.

trees.name: Alchemy
trees.text: XP per brew: salve 3, tier 1 potions 5, tier 2 10, tier 3 20, Heroes' Draught 30. Herbs are gathered with Harvest.

trees.name: Building
trees.text: XP: placing crafted building blocks (anything made at a workbench, stonecutter, loom or furnace that is a block: planks, bricks, glass, stairs; not dirt, raw stone or logs): 0.5 per block under the §3 limits. A home validated for the first time: 25 XP. Each new comfort point of your home: 10 XP.

trees.name: Attack
trees.text: XP: melee damage dealt to hostile mobs and bosses × 0.5; to animals × 0.25. Players: 0.

trees.name: Archery
trees.text: XP: ranged damage dealt to hostile mobs and bosses × 0.5 (animals × 0.25), +2 per hit at more than 30 blocks.

trees.name: Defense
trees.text: XP: damage from hostile mobs and bosses absorbed by your armour × 1; damage blocked with a shield or weapon × 1.5 (§3 for exclusions).

trees.name: Athletics
trees.text: XP: 1 per 20 blocks sprinted, 1 per 10 blocks swum, 1 per 5 blocks climbed (ladders, vines, mantles); new-cell rule in §3.
